title: Chugalkhor Bahuriya
desc: Rani Chatterjee stars in this entertaining, thrilling film directed by Istiaq Sheikh Bunti, delivering suspense and engaging performances throughout the story.

desc: In a comedic village war of wits, a mother-in-law and daughter-in-law run rival 'pathsalas' of rules and etiquette. Clashes, clever one-upmanship, and family drama unite in laughter and surprises.

title: Laakhon Me Ek Paule Baani Hum Bahurani
desc: After arriving at her in-laws' home, Sheetal is disturbed by her sisters-in-law's rude behavior toward their mothers-in-law. She takes it upon herself to change them, but her efforts soon lead to unexpected conflicts and difficulties.

desc: Mahendra Nath, weary of his two sharp-tongued wives, hoped his daughters-in-law would stand up to them. But the bitter rivalry between the mothers-in-law and daughters-in-law escalated into a tragic accident.

title: Nandini
